messages:
mel: Heads-up — legal team asked for a per-tenant legal-hold toggle with export guarantees for SOC2 evidence. Need product/ops input.

jordan: question — do they need immediate freeze or snapshotting? Both have perf/cost tradeoffs.

mel: They want immediate freeze + immutable snapshot within 30s for preservation. Also need export within 24h SLA.

nina: that's going to blow storage and throughput on cold archive. We should propose retention tiers instead: short (30d), medium (1y), long (7y + legalhold). Legalhold overrides TTL.

sam: +1 on tiers. Need a KMS/BYOK handshake to ensure exported evidence is decryptable for customer. Ops: can we guarantee export from vaulted keys?

ops-bot: deploy-prod completed: retention-config-service v2.3 rolled out.

suzanne: On BYOK — legal wants key escrow proof that we didn't exfiltrate keys. That implies KMS-escrow integration + attestation docs.

mel: For SOC2, we also need audit log immutability/append-only (merkle root?) and proof of chain-of-custody. Proposed MVP: append-only events, per-tenant export endpoint, legalhold flag, BYOK handshake doc.

jordan: timeline? Q3 ok? We need eng, infra, and security sign-off. Also add acceptance criteria: 1) legalhold prevents TTL; 2) export job completes within 24h; 3) logs are immutable for retention period; 4) BYOK handshake documented and tested.

nina: unblockers: storage S3 lifecycle rules + object lock for long term; vault rotation policy; test dataset.

sam: I can own export job + KMS integration. Will need product spec for API shape (toggle, retention, export).

mel: API sketch:
```
POST /v1/tenants/:id/legalhold
body: { "enabled": true, "reason": "legal subpoena", "expires_at": null }
GET /v1/tenants/:id/audit-exports/:job_id
```

suzanne: add: audit export must include signing metadata, merkle proofs, and key id used to encrypt.

mel: Ok. Action items: @sam draft API doc by Fri, @nina get cost estimate + S3/object-lock feasibility by Tue, @jordan draft rollout plan & tests by Wed. @suzanne prepare BYOK escrow acceptance criteria.

jordan: also add rollback/expiry policy: if legalhold expires, we should snapshot and then apply TTL; must record chain-of-custody timestamp.

ops-bot: incident-note: last-week's export job timed out for tenant t-42 (trace: export-2025-03-11-22). Suggest adding retry/backoff.

nina: noted. We'll include backoff and requeue. Also propose a "retention-class" per route for routing to dedicated storage.

sam: one more ask from sales: per-tenant SLA adjustment (faster export window) as paid feature.

mel: put that in backlog as optional premium. For MVP we stick to uniform 24h SLA.

suzanne: security QA: need threat model for export API (signed requests, okta scopes), and e2e test for BYOK key possession.

mel: Thanks everyone. I'll compile and put in product board. Short follow-up: can everyone confirm owners? @sam, @nina, @jordan, @suzanne

sam: I'm in.

nina: I'm in.

jordan: in.

suzanne: in.

mel: Closing thread — I'll post the spec link here when ready: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ENT-RET-123
